general.notes: SFP+ Direct Attach Copper Cable (DAC); not an optical transceiver. Transmission reach stated as up to 7 m (Features) and cable lengths 0.5, 1, 3, 5, 7 m (Ordering Information). Operating temperature: Features and -40~85℃ NI order codes use -40 to +85°C; General Product Characteristics and N-suffix order codes state 0 to +70°C or -40 to +85°C. Supply voltage 3.3 V nominal; no electrical power consumption in Watts given. High Speed Characteristics include electrical parameters only (e.g. dWDPc max 6.75 dB, VMA Loss max 4.4 dB). Pin table references INF-8074i for I2C lines. Wire gauge 30 AWG (1 m, 3 m) and 24 AWG (5 m, 7 m) per Mechanical Specifications.
general.suggestions: Consider reach_m or reach_length_m for copper DAC products; optional temp_min_c/temp_max_c as lists or variant tags (N vs NI) when one datasheet covers multiple temperature grades.
